Question (for now) : "How temperatures affect the number of rented bikes"


```{r load-data}
# load your data 
seoul_bikes_raw <- read_csv("data/SeoulBikeData.csv", locale=locale(encoding="latin1")) #extracting raw data, locale needed to be specified as error otherwise.
seoul_bikes <- seoul_bikes_raw |> clean_names() #cleaning names to snake_case, as column headings' words initially separated with space
seoul_bikes

library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

seoul_bikes <- seoul_bikes %>%
  mutate(
    wind_group = cut(
      wind_speed_m_s,
      breaks = c(-Inf, 1, 2, 3, 4, Inf),
      labels = c("0-1", "1-2", "2-3", "3-4", "4+")
    )
  )

ggplot(seoul_bikes,
       aes(x = wind_group,
           y = rented_bike_count)) +
  stat_summary(
    fun = mean,
    geom = "col",
    fill = "steelblue"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Average Bike Rentals at Different Wind Speeds",
    x = "Wind Speed (m/s)",
    y = "Average Number of Bikes Rented"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

Initial Plots
```{r}
seoul_bikes |>  ggplot(data = _, mapping = aes(x = temperature_c, y = rented_bike_count)) +
  geom_point(mapping = aes(color = holiday, alpha = visibility_10m, shape = seasons)) +
  geom_smooth(se = FALSE) + 
  facet_wrap( ~ holiday) +
  labs(x = "Temperature",
       y = "Rent Bike Count",
       title = "How Temperatures Affects the Quantity of Bikes Rented",
       colour = "Holiday",
       shape = "Season",
       alpha = "Visibility (10m)"
      )
#will need scaling later to make sure points are more visible

seoul_bikes |>  ggplot(data = _, mapping = aes(x = temperature_c, y = rented_bike_count)) +
  geom_bin_2d()

seoul_bikes |> ggplot(data = _, mapping = aes(x = rented_bike_count, fill = seasons)) +
  geom_density(mapping = aes(alpha = 0.5)) +
  facet_wrap(~ holiday, scales = "free") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma)

seoul_bikes |> ggplot(data = _, mapping = aes(x = rented_bike_count, fill = seasons)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30) +
  facet_grid(seasons ~ holiday, scales = "free")

seoul_bikes |> ggplot(data = _, mapping = aes(x = seasons, y = rented_bike_count)) +
  geom_boxplot()

seoul_bikes |> ggplot(mapping = aes(x = rented_bike_count, fill = holiday, alpha = 0.1)) +
  geom_density()

seoul_bikes |> ggplot(mapping = aes(x = hour, y = rented_bike_count)) +
  geom_col() +
  facet_grid(seasons ~ holiday, scales = "free") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma)

seoul_bikes |> mutate(
  snow = ifelse(snowfall_cm == 0, FALSE, TRUE)
) |> 
  ggplot(mapping = aes(x = rented_bike_count, color = snow, alpha = 0.1)) +
  geom_density() +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma)
```

Questions:
1. How temperature impacts count of rented bikes
2. How seasons impact count of rented bikes
3. Relationship of holidays and rented bike count
4. How time of day affects rented bike count
5. How snowfall affects rented bike count
6. How rainfall affects rented bike count
